content.summary: A retrieval cabinet ignores a bronze bird and lifts two adult attendants. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.recommended_input: Two clearly adult museum attendants inspect one small bronze bird inside a retrieval cabinet. Lower the arm until its prongs surround the bird but do not close on it. Lift both adult attendants together while the untouched bronze bird remains visible inside the cabinet.

invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.

invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The target remains behind as proof of failed retrieval."

invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The human lift is playful, non-injurious and physically readable."
